name: semantic-memory
context: Agents needing durable factual knowledge beyond the context window: curated facts are embedded in a knowledge store queried by similarity at prompt time.
avoid_when: Knowledge is tiny and static (put it in the prompt)
The knowledge base is small and fits entirely within the context window
anti_patterns: Pure vector retrieval without graph traversal for relational queries
design_principles: Resolve fact conflicts at write or read time, never silently prefer latest
Implement TTL-based re-indexing by freshness tier
best_practices: Implement hybrid retrieval: vector similarity + graph traversal for relational queries
Track retrieval hops guidance: 1-3 for simple, 5-10 for multi-hop research
references: Park et al., Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03442
Packer et al., MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems, 2023 — https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.08560
CoALA (Sumers et al. 2023) - authoritative taxonomy for semantic/episodic/procedural memory distinction
